attchmntText: Manomay Tex India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Rpt 30.09.2026'.
voiceSummary: Manomay Tex India Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the second quarter ended 31st March 2027. The board approved these results on 13th November 2026. The company operates in the manufacturing and trading of denim fabric, cotton yarn, and denim garments. The filing includes disclosures of related party transactions with entities controlled by promoters and the promoters group. These transactions involve the purchase of goods and services and are approved by the Audit Committee. The total monetary value of such transactions is subject to a maximum limit of Rs. 500 crore for the financial year 2026-27. Specific transaction values disclosed include Rs. 1084.36 lakhs with Everstrong Marketing Private Limited and Rs. 81.64 lakhs with Fornax Fashion Private Limited. The updated Related Party Transactions policy was uploaded on 31st August 2026. No default on loans or debt securities was reported.

attchmntText: Pursuant to Regulation 30 & 33 of the SEBI (Listing obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ("Listing Regulations"), we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company in its Meeting held on 13th November,2026
voiceSummary: Manomay Tex India Limited Board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of 11951.05 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 4322.68 lakhs in the same period last year. Profit before tax was 868.70 lakhs for the quarter, versus 744.13 lakhs previously. For the half year, revenue from operations stood at 33009.02 lakhs, with profit before tax at 1532.10 lakhs. Earnings per share were 3.09 basic and 3.61 diluted for the quarter. The trading window for directors and designated employees opens on November 16, 2026.
